title: pvForceStaticMesh
body:
## pvForceStaticMesh

Caches the geometry and topology of its input the first time it runs and keeps reusing that mesh for later time steps, updating only point, cell and field data while the point and cell counts stay the same. Use it after readers or filters that rebuild an unchanged mesh at every time step, so that downstream work depending only on the mesh need not be repeated. It handles an unstructured grid, polydata, or the first block of a composite input when that block is an unstructured grid.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- If the mesh really moves or is remeshed with the same counts, the cached geometry is wrong, and ParaView 5.13.3 offers no way to force the cache to recompute: ForceCacheComputation has no elements, so invoking it sends no message, and assigning it pushes the XML command SetCacheComputation, which vtkForceStaticMesh lacks (it has SetForceCacheComputation) and which aborts the native process. Schemaxis therefore does not expose it. Use a different filter chain for meshes that change.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ForceStaticMesh`. Identity: `filters/ForceStaticMesh`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid); polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGrid","vtkPolyData","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {
    "ForceCacheComputation": "zero-element property with no usable native command"
  },
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvForceStaticMesh",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
